evidence.claim: New Hope traces its history to 1923, when African American sharecropper families lived there during Penney’s crop experiments.
evidence.quote: The New Hope Community is a vibrant part of the Town of Penney Farms with a history that dates back to 1923 when J.C. Penney experimented with farming different types of crops. At that time, the New Hope community was known as the “The Colored Quarter” and housed African American families called “sharecroppers”.
